g.text: RetailFlow - UNKNOWN reconciliation and exact replay
BEGIN / validate actor, ACCEPTED return, key, units
replayed = true / original IDs and response
insert logical refund, attempt, key response, audit
No retry while PENDING or UNKNOWN.
A later exact replay still returns its original
BEGIN / validate provider role, reference, event ID
[mismatched reference or reused event ID with changed data]
insert event / mark attempt and refund SUCCEEDED
mark return COMPLETED / append audit / COMMIT
Production outbox, provider signatures and durable
recovery require a separate integration increment.
